2123859521735205093.en_summary: NVIDIA extends drop to 9.9% on report of SEC accounting probe. The probe is exploring potential accounting issues, sources say, with new lows for $NVDA.
2123859521735205093.zh_summary: NVIDIA 因有關 SEC 會計調查的報導，跌幅擴大至 9.9%。據消息人士稱，該調查正探討潛在的會計問題，$NVDA 創下新低。

2123859191701905583.en_summary: Call me cynical, but the $NVDA headline drip doesn't pass the smell test. A fresh negative story almost every single day on a stock already down. That's not how organic news usually flows. IMO someone has been working this story hard. Doesn't matter who or why. We don't fight it and we don't marry it. Price leads, headlines follow, and we trade price. Have an eye on the 115 to 120 area.
2123859191701905583.zh_summary: 叫我憤世嫉俗吧，但 $NVDA 的頭條滴灌不通過氣味測試。幾乎每天都有新的負面故事，打在已經下跌的股票上。這不是有機新聞通常的流動方式。我認為有人一直在努力推動這個故事。不管是誰或為什麼。我們不對抗它，也不與它結婚。價格領先，頭條跟隨，我們交易價格。留意 115 至 120 區域。

2123857585145278784.en_summary: JUST IN: $NVDA is facing scrutiny from the Securities and Exchange Commission regarding potential accounting issues.
2123857585145278784.zh_summary: 最新消息：$NVDA 正面臨證券交易委員會關於潛在會計問題的審查。
